description:
The TUI's keyboard input pipeline — Terminal → StdinFSM → KeyParser → Keybindings → Input/Interactive — is functional but has significant gaps compared to upstream pi-mono. This epic tracks the missing pieces across six layers: protocol negotiation, sequence buffering, key parsing, keybinding infrastructure, editor/input features, and app-level shortcuts.

Reference upstream files:
- `packages/tui/src/terminal.ts` (ProcessTerminal)
- `packages/tui/src/stdin-buffer.ts` (StdinBuffer)
- `packages/tui/src/keys.ts` (matchesKey/parseKey)
- `packages/tui/src/keybindings.ts` (KeybindingsManager)
- `packages/tui/src/components/editor.ts` (Editor)
- `packages/coding-agent/src/core/keybindings.ts` (AppKeybindings)
- `packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts`
title: TUI keyboard handling parity with upstream pi-mono
